entries.title: Tiles over a bin fill heat map
entries.caption: The inventory app, Floor tab: six tiles (bin fill, stock value, below reorder, average cover, fill rate, dock to stock) over a bin fill heat map by aisle and shelf, then the Reorder tab as a low stock table with bars and marks. The heat map needs Bolt 0.1.182 or newer, the tile visuals and the table bars 0.1.184, and the tabs 0.1.185, which is not in a public release yet. The pictures are unedited captures of a real Bolt running this example on its sample data.

images.alt: The inventory app, Floor tab: tabs Floor, Reorder 16 and Movement above six tiles (bin fill 70 percent, stock value 85 k, below reorder 16, average cover 21 days, fill rate 97.4 percent, dock to stock 6.2 hours) and a bin fill heat map by aisle and shelf, from Shelf 1 to Shelf 6 of Aisle 1 to Aisle 4, each cell in a blue step.
Animation: the inventory app, Floor tab with its tiles and heat map, then the Reorder tab with the low stock table, then the Movement tab.

entries.how: Copy `kit/examples/inventory`; the Floor tab is a `kind: stack` with a `kind: cards` child and a `kind: heatmap` child (0.1.182).

entries.title: A margin ring, a marked trend and the numbers
entries.caption: The finance app, Trend tab: the operating margin as a gauge, then the margin by month as a line against a plan line with the Price, Freeze and FX marks, then the revenue run rate as an area chart. The animation walks the Overview tiles, this Trend tab and the Detail table. The gauge pane needs Bolt 0.1.182 or newer, the chart limit line and the marks 0.1.184, and the tabs 0.1.185, which is not in a public release yet. The pictures are unedited captures of a real Bolt running this example on its sample data.

images.alt: The finance app, Trend tab: a 20.8 percent operating margin gauge (the gauge pane needs Bolt 0.1.182 or newer) and a line chart of operating margin by month with a plan line and the Price, Freeze and FX marks.
Animation: the finance app, Overview tab with its tiles, then the Trend tab with the margin ring and the marked line chart, then the Detail tab with the variance table.

entries.how: Copy `kit/examples/finance-pnl`; the Trend tab is a `kind: stack` with a `kind: gauge` child (0.1.182) and two `kind: chart` children, one of them with `limit` and `marker`.

entries.title: A variance table with bars and marks
entries.caption: The finance app, Detail tab: the twelve business units with the revenue of each as a bar, the variance against plan and a tone mark per row. The table bars and the marks need Bolt 0.1.184 or newer and the tabs 0.1.185, which is not in a public release yet. The picture is an unedited capture of a real Bolt running this example on its sample data.

images.alt: The =finance-pnl Detail tab: a table of the twelve business units with the revenue of each as a bar, the variance against plan and a tone mark per row.

entries.how: Copy `kit/examples/finance-pnl`; the Detail tab table gives one column `bars` and one column `mark`.

entries.title: A queue table with bars and marks, then an SLA ring
entries.caption: The support desk app, Queue tab: the team rating and the oldest open ticket as tiles, a filter box, then the open tickets with the age of each as a bar and a tone mark for the SLA state. The SLA tab then shows the week at 91 percent as a gauge with the 85 percent floor under it, then SLA met per day as bars against a 95 percent target line with the days it slipped marked. The gauge pane needs Bolt 0.1.182 or newer, the chart limit line and the marks 0.1.184, and the tabs 0.1.185, which is not in a public release yet. The pictures are unedited captures of a real Bolt running this example on its sample data.

images.alt: The support desk app, Queue tab: tiles for the team rating and the oldest open ticket, a filter box, then a table of the open tickets with the age of each as a bar and a tone mark for the SLA state.

The support desk app, SLA tab: a 91 percent SLA gauge (the gauge pane needs Bolt 0.1.182 or newer) over a bar chart of SLA met per day against a 95 percent target line, with the days it slipped marked.

entries.how: Copy `kit/examples/support-desk`; the SLA tab is a `kind: stack` with a `kind: gauge` child (0.1.182) and a bar `kind: chart` with `limit` and `marker`.

entries.title: Tiles, a spend chart and tables
entries.caption: The marketing campaigns app, Overview tab: spend, ROI, conversions, budget used, click rate and cost per sale as tiles, then spend by channel as a donut chart, then weekly spend as a line against the weekly average with the events marked. The donut chart needs Bolt 0.1.182 or newer and the tabs 0.1.185, which is not in a public release yet. The picture is an unedited capture of a real Bolt running this example on its sample data.

images.alt: The =marketing-campaigns Overview tab: tabs Overview, Campaigns, Creatives and Watch above six tiles (spend 555 k, ROI 194 percent, conversions 19808, budget used 72 percent, click rate 2.9 percent, cost per sale 28 USD) and a donut chart of spend by channel (the donut chart needs Bolt 0.1.182 or newer).

entries.how: Copy `kit/examples/marketing-campaigns`; the Overview tab is a `kind: stack` with a `kind: cards` child and two `kind: chart` children, one of them with `type: donut` (0.1.182).

entries.title: A savings ring, a spend chart and a teams table
entries.caption: The cloud cost app, Overview tab: the anomalies and the cost per order as tiles, the savings plan coverage as a gauge at 71 percent over the 60 percent floor, then the monthly spend by service as an area chart with the limit line and the SageMaker launch and savings plan budget marks. The Teams tab then shows the teams that spend the money, with the spend of each as a bar and a tone mark for the ones over budget. The gauge pane needs Bolt 0.1.182 or newer, the chart limit line and the marks 0.1.184, and the tabs 0.1.185, which is not in a public release yet. The pictures are unedited captures of a real Bolt running this example on its sample data.

images.alt: The cloud cost app, Overview tab: tiles for the anomalies and the cost per order, a 71 percent savings plan coverage gauge (the gauge pane needs Bolt 0.1.182 or newer) over the 60 percent floor, then an area chart of the monthly spend by service with a limit line and the SageMaker launch and savings plan budget marks.
The cloud cost app, Teams tab: tiles for the teams that spend the money and a table of the spend of each as a bar, the share of the budget used and a tone mark per team.

entries.how: Copy `kit/examples/cloud-cost`; the Teams tab table gives one column `bars` and one column `mark`.

entries.title: A fix time ring with a target
entries.caption: The security posture app, Posture tab: open findings, critical open, past SLA, fixed this week, fixed within SLA and scan coverage as six tiles, then the median days to fix as a gauge at 20 days against the 14 day target. The gauge pane needs Bolt 0.1.182 or newer and the tabs 0.1.185, which is not in a public release yet. The picture is an unedited capture of a real Bolt running this example on its sample data.

images.alt: The =security-posture Posture tab: tabs Posture, Findings 24 and Trend above six tiles (open findings 30, critical open 2, past SLA 4, fixed this week 11, fixed within SLA 87 percent, scan coverage 94 percent) and a 20 day median days to fix gauge (the gauge pane needs Bolt 0.1.182 or newer) against a 14 day target.

entries.how: Copy `kit/examples/security-posture`; the Posture tab is a `kind: stack` with a `kind: cards` child and a `kind: gauge` child (0.1.182).

entries.title: Four panes in one view
entries.caption: A wellness benefit on one pane: a ring, four tiles, a trend chart against an even pace, then the claims list. The gauge pane and the area chart need Bolt 0.1.182 or newer, and the stack pane 0.1.184, so this example needs Bolt 0.1.184. The picture is drawn by Bolt's own pane renderer from this example's sample data, not a capture of a running Bolt.

images.alt: The =gym right pane: a 94 percent ring marked WATCH 80 percent, four tiles (left this year 38 USD, approved 453 USD, pending 109, per month 62 USD), an area chart of claims against an even pace with a cap line and a Yoga event mark, then a claims table with bars and ok, warn and error marks.

entries.how: Copy `kit/examples/gym`; the overview view uses `kind: stack` with `bind.children`, one child per pane, and `visual_from` so every tile picks its own visual.

entries.title: A tile row, then a chart per takeaway
entries.caption: Four tiles, then one chart per takeaway: revenue against plan, cash against a floor, and customers. The stack pane needs Bolt 0.1.184 or newer and the area chart 0.1.182. The picture is drawn by Bolt's own pane renderer from this example's sample data, not a capture of a running Bolt.

images.alt: The =exec-brief right pane: four tiles (revenue Dec 6.2 M, cash 21.9 M, customers 441, churn 1.4 percent), then a line chart of revenue against plan with Price and Launch marks, then a cash area chart with a floor line, then a customers line chart.

entries.how: Copy `kit/examples/exec-brief`; every chart carries a `label` that states the takeaway, and `marker` puts an event on the chart.

entries.title: A pipeline in one pane
entries.caption: Open pipeline against commit, the four numbers that matter, the stage funnel and the top ten deals. The stack pane needs Bolt 0.1.184 or newer and the area chart 0.1.182. The picture is drawn by Bolt's own pane renderer from this example's sample data, not a capture of a running Bolt.

images.alt: The =sales-pipeline right pane: an area chart of open pipeline 5.5 M against commit 4.4 M with a quota x3 limit line and Webinar and Launch marks, four tiles (open pipeline 5.5 M, coverage 3.2 x, win rate 27 percent, sales cycle 46 d), a stage funnel table with bars, then a top ten deals table with bars, idle days and ok, warn and error flags.

entries.how: Copy `kit/examples/sales-pipeline`; the funnel table uses column `bars` and `mark`, and the deals table sums the column.
